payload.name: pc-check-tcp-port-list
payload.description: Pure-logic guard that validates a raw TCP-port list before any network action. Target input contract: ports is a nonempty list of exact integers, each in 1..65535 inclusive. Booleans are invalid (a bool is not an integer). Missing, null, scalar, empty, bool-element and out-of-range values fail closed by returning valid=false with ports=[]; no exception is raised. This is a raw validator: it inspects the candidate shape itself and does not assume an earlier binding stage already validated it. The outer input contract admits the raw candidate list while the inner validation implements the rule. Missing and null remain distinct (both yield valid=false, ports=[]). Typed inputs are a target interface, not guaranteed deployed runtime support; the step-local inputs mapping must be implemented by the runner. This component makes zero host.<tool>(...) calls and is deterministic pure logic. It grants no dispatch permission and does not replace live policy, cancellation or actual deduplication evidence. No approval claims.
